name: harz-vault-v01-spec-20261009
description: HARZ Vault v0.1 spec: content-addressed sovereign storage protocol — durable-record-is-truth, idempotent resumable ingestion, hash-verified delivery, honest LIVE/CACHED/OFFLINE/STALE, provider-independent interface, capacity-aware, 10 acceptance tests (T1-T10) including death tests. Replication deferred to v0.2 after core passes. Build approved by sovereign storage ruling Oct 9 2026.
content:
{
  "name": "HARZ Vault v0.1 \u2014 Sovereign Storage Protocol Spec",
  "version": "0.1 (design; build approved by sovereign storage ruling 2026-10-09)",
  "principle": "The durable record is the truth. A document is not safely stored because an ingestion request succeeded.",
  "document_identity": {
    "did": "vault doc id = sha256(raw text bytes) \u2014 content-addressed, dedup identity",
    "norm_did": "sha256(normalized text) \u2014 near-dup detection mirror of corpus norm_hash",
    "manifest_entry": "did, size, source, url, fetched_at, language, ingest_state, created_at, integrity: {algo: sha256, verified_at, by}"
  },
  "core_commands": [
    "vault.put(doc) -> durable write: content written and fsync-equivalent, manifest row committed, THEN acknowledged. Partial write leaves ingest_state=partial with resume offset.",
    "vault.get(did) -> returns content verified against hash before delivery; mismatch = hard failure, never silent.",
    "vault.verify(did) -> recompute hash, compare, record result; batch mode anchors into a verification log.",
    "vault.resume(did) -> re-request from last durable offset; no duplicate logical docs (idempotent by did).",
    "vault.export_manifest(range) -> ordered manifest stream for migration and backup jobs.",
    "vault.status() -> honest state per doc: LIVE / CACHED / OFFLINE / STALE + node/copy counts + capacity truth."
  ],
  "state_laws": "LIVE = hash verified from a reachable node this session. CACHED = stored locally, not re-verified now. OFFLINE = local functionality, no network verification. STALE = exists but freshness unguaranteed. Never display cached as live.",
  "storage_interface": "provider-independent adapter interface (local filesystem / Node 1 storage, optional cloud adapter later). The protocol code must run unchanged on a plain Node with no Cloudflare account.",
  "capacity_awareness": "every node reports real free bytes; puts refuse honestly when capacity insufficient (mirror of corpus 507 law); no hiding behind provider dashboards.",
  "node_protocol_v02_later": "multi-node replication (3 verified copies) comes AFTER single-node protocol passes all death tests. A node registry manifest; eligibility: storage, integrity response, availability. Nodes replaceable; registry never assumes a specific host.",
  "acceptance_tests_v01": [
    "T1 fresh store: put 100 docs -> 100 manifest rows, 100 verified hashes, ack only after durable write",
    "T2 idempotence: re-put same 100 -> 0 new rows, 0 duplicates, honest 'already stored' response",
    "T3 interruption: kill ingest mid-batch -> partial states recorded -> resume completes with exactly-once logical insert",
    "T4 integrity: flip one byte on disk -> vault.get returns HARD FAILURE naming the did, never wrong content",
    "T5 restart recovery: stop node, restart -> manifest replay, verify all 100, zero loss",
    "T6 offline retrieval: airplane-mode equivalent (no network path) -> local docs served with OFFLINE label",
    "T7 honest states: unreachable remote content shows OFFLINE/STALE truth, never blank screen, never cached-as-live",
    "T8 capacity truth: fill to node limit -> put refused honestly with real free-byte count",
    "T9 cursor continuation: export corpus ids 1..N, interrupt, resume -> no gap, no duplicate in manifest",
    "T10 parity: same corpus through D1 and Vault -> identical doc counts, identical content hashes, identical logical identities (norm dedup parity)"
  ],
  "migration_stance": "Stage 3 only after all T1-T10 pass. Resumable, reversible, originals never deleted on new-system success alone."
}
